title: Propexo Launches on Hacker News
summary: The software startup is taking part in the prestigious Y Combinator startup accelerator program
body_markdown:
Propexo (fka Propify), the innovative property management system API aggregator, today announced its official launch on Hacker News as part of Y Combinator's Winter 2023 batch.


Co-founded by Remen Okoruwa, Ben Keller, and Nick Johnson, Propexo introduces a modern REST API solution that streamlines integration with multiple property management systems.


The platform addresses critical challenges in the real estate technology sector by abstracting complex, legacy APIs into a single, developer-friendly interface. By offering features such as webhook support, comprehensive documentation, and reliable infrastructure, Propify aims to revolutionize how proptech companies connect with property management systems.


Property technology developers and companies interested in modernizing their real estate software integration can learn more about Propexo's launch at[Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=35170955) .
